source_name: CNBC: Stripe closes $1.1 billion Bridge deal
caveat: Press-reported price, US dollars. Stripe's own release gives no price, so this figure is shown as reported and never charted.

source_name: The New York Times: Stripe buys OpenRouter for $7.5 billion
caveat: Paywalled press report, US dollars, citing a single person familiar with the deal; Stripe has not confirmed it. Reuters separately reported slightly more than $8B. Never charted.
Press report from one anonymous source, US dollars; it conflicts with the $7.5B figure reported by the New York Times. Kept side by side rather than averaged. Never charted.
Press report citing people familiar with the matter, US dollars; Tempo did not announce terms in a release read here. Shown as reported, never charted.

source_name: MarketScreener (Publicnow) repost of Affirm Q4 2026 Shareholder Letter
caveat: Fiscal Q4 2026 GMV in USD as printed in Affirm's letter; read here from a third-party repost because the SEC copy of the letter is image-only. The audited full-year GMV is the charted figure.

source_name: The Business Times: Airwallex raises US$320 million Series H round
caveat: Conflicts with the company's own $1.3 billion for the same month; kept beside it rather than averaged. The company figure governs.

source_name: Mostly Metrics (Brex-sponsored partnership piece): Brex's Third Chapter
caveat: Appears in a newsletter piece written under a paid partnership with Brex, not in a Brex statement. 'Gross' annualized revenue may differ from net revenue. Never charted.

source_name: Checkout.com newsroom: reaches $750m in annualised net revenue
caveat: A company forecast for a year still in progress, not a result. Not charted as an actual; compare only with the 2025 actual once the year closes.

source_name: The Next Web, citing Bloomberg: Ramp eyes $60bn valuation
caveat: Press report only, not confirmed by Ramp. Ramp's own figure for the same date is 'over $1 billion'. Shown beside the company figure, never charted.

source_name: The Next Web, citing Bloomberg: Ramp eyes $60bn valuation
caveat: Talks, not a closed round: Ramp declined to comment and terms could change. About $1 billion of primary funding is under discussion. Never charted.

source_name: Calcalist (Ctech): Rapyd raises $500M at $4.5B valuation to complete $610M PayU acquisition
caveat: Forward-looking press statement ('will ... generate revenues exceeding $1 billion'), not a company-reported result; basis (gross or net) unknown. Never charted.

source_name: Calcalist (Ctech): Rapyd raises $500M at $4.5B valuation to complete $610M PayU acquisition
caveat: Press report ('Calcalist has learned'); Rapyd's own completion release names the investors but no valuation. Down from about $10 billion in 2021. Never charted.

source_name: RTE News: Stripe's annual revenues for 2025 jump by 33%
caveat: Gross turnover of one regional entity (EMEA and APAC), not Stripe group revenue. Prior-year comparative as reported by RTE.

source_name: RTE News: Stripe's annual revenues for 2025 jump by 33%
caveat: Regional entity only. Rounded to $0.1 billion in the source. Turnover minus cost of sales gives a gross margin for this entity only, not for Stripe group.

source_name: RTE News: Stripe's annual revenues for 2025 jump by 33%
caveat: Regional entity only (EMEA and APAC); intra-group charges affect this figure, so it does not measure Stripe group profitability.

source_name: RTE News: Stripe's annual revenues for 2025 jump by 33%
caveat: Gross turnover of one regional entity (EMEA and APAC), not Stripe group revenue and not net revenue: it includes processing fees passed on to card issuers and networks (cost of sales was $5.3 billion). Figure as reported by RTE from the filed accounts.
